title: Implementation of a Consensus-Based Discharge Protocol for Preterm Infants With Lung Disease
official: Implementation of a Consensus-Based Discharge Protocol for Preterm Infants With Lung Disease
summary: The researchers have worked to create consensus recommendations among national efforts to help with the transition and coordination of care for preterm infants with lung disease around discharge from the neonatal intensive care unit to home. This study looks to evaluate implementation of the recommendations at Boston Children's Hospital and referring NICU's (Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center and Brigham and Women's Hospital). Specifically, the research team will be looking at follow-up rates, healthcare utilization, and parental satisfaction/feedback with implementation of these guidelines.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Preterm infants born \<32 weeks with at least mild BPD, defined as 28 days of respiratory support after birth.
* Efforts will be made to include a mix of infants with mild, moderate, and severe BPD, including infants discharged on oxygen.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Discharge to a location other than home.
* Infants with other congenital disease (cardiac, genetic, neurological) thought to contribute significantly to their respiratory disease.
